participation.context: Kept to Gaunt, and refused an early count.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the second act as the end of the part, and closed the rehearsal.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Confirmed the join, and kept the rest of the king from the door.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

story.body: You rehearsed the book as it stands. You did not restore a cut scene, and you did not count the performance in advance.

title: Rehearsed Gaunt as the book is played

participation.context: Named the sixth time only after the play, and refused a patron made of a fist.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Gave the account of the house, and took the fist for clapping.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Guessed a country justice, and stopped the guess there.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Asked if the man clapped, and left the answer as it was.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Entered three paid and no name.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

relations.note: the boxes, and no name beyond the cloak

story.body: You came off Gaunt and heard Margery's report. You agreed not to name the man. You did not treat the Rose bill as money. You went toward home and a candle.

relations.note: the boxes, and no name beyond the cloak

title: Heard of the man in the frieze cloak
